title: Home guide: Will it degrade? Soil jars
subject: Science
unit: Spring 1: Everyday materials and how they change (Muck, Mess & Mixtures and Will It Degrade?)
source: Written for science/y2 lesson 8 (Home practical guide and safety card: Will It Degrade? soil jars (portal worksheet): adult helps, gloves if available, wash hands)
intro: Read it all first, then do it with an adult nearby.

practical.aim: Find out which materials rot in soil.
equipment: Four clear jars or cut plastic bottles (an adult cuts)
Garden soil and a little water
Banana peel, a strip of paper, a piece of plastic bag, a piece of old cotton cloth
safety: Wear gloves if you have them; wash your hands after touching soil
Keep the jars out of reach of babies and pets
An adult knows what you are doing and stays nearby
Clear a space; tidy up and wash your hands afterwards
method: Half fill each jar with soil.
Put one material in each jar and cover it with a little more soil.
Add a few drops of water so the soil is damp.
Write your prediction for each jar.
Put the jars in a safe place. Check them in two weeks.
